description: This file defines a Perl package for handling blacklist result sets, including methods for adding values to the blacklist and checking if a value is blacklisted, with support for different blacklist types such as cleartext, sha256_b64, and wildcard.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Component::ResultSet::Blacklist
classes.description: A class representing a result set for blacklist entries, providing methods to add and verify blacklist entries.

methods.name: _add_value
methods.description: Adds a value to the blacklist, processing it according to the blacklist type (cleartext, sha256_b64, or wildcard).

methods.name: _is_value_ok
methods.description: Checks if a given value is not blacklisted based on existing blacklist entries.
